name: Ducati Scrambler 800
engine: 803 cc air-cooled L-twin, Desmodue, fuel injected, belt-driven cams
intro: Ducati's air-cooled Scrambler. The cam belts and valve service on schedule are the big jobs.

A-002.title: Check for open recalls
A-002.instructions: Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls. Recalls include a side stand pivot nut on 2015-2016 bikes, the front brake master cylinder on 2017-2018 Cafe Racers (17V812), and turn signals on 2021 Night Shift bikes (21V361).
A-002.reason: The side stand and brake recalls are safety items. Repairs are free.

add.title: Check cam belt age and valve service
add.instructions: Find out when the cam belts were last replaced and when the desmo valves were last checked. If you can't prove it, do both.
add.reason: A cam belt that breaks wrecks the engine.

recalls.what: Front brake master cylinder may fail.
recalls.fix: Dealer replaces the master cylinder piston free.
